item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00173","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C23","C01","C03"],"selected_candidate_label":"C23","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C23 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template: it is a closely preceding Eisenhower order and reproduces the child's entire operative structure and nearly all substantive wording, with only the carrier, employee representative, and date changed. C01 is similarly near-identical, while C03 is especially relevant because it applies the same machinery to the same Pennsylvania Railroad but is older and contains a slightly different description of the threatened disruption.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"WHEREAS a dispute exists between the Pennsylvania Railroad, a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the Transport Workers Union of America, C.I.O., Railroad Division, a labor organization","parent_excerpt":"WHEREAS a dispute exists between the New York Central System, Lines East, a carrier, and certain of its employees represented by the Order of Railway Conductors and Brakemen, a labor organization","explanation":"The opening predicate uses the same sentence-level template, substituting the carrier and labor organization."},{"child_excerpt":"WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended; and WHEREAS this dispute, in the judgment of the National Mediation Board, threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce to a degree such as to deprive a section of the country of essential transportation service","parent_excerpt":"WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended; and WHEREAS this dispute, in the judgment of the National Mediation Board, threatens substantially to interrupt interstate commerce to a degree such as to deprive a section of the country of essential transportation service","explanation":"The two central findings are verbatim and appear in the same sequence."},{"child_excerpt":"The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.","parent_excerpt":"The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.","explanation":"The reporting mandate is identical."},{"child_excerpt":"As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the Pennsylvania Railroad, or by its employees, in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.","parent_excerpt":"As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the New York Central System, Lines East, or by its employees, in the conditions out of which the said dispute arose.","explanation":"The statutory standstill mechanism is copied almost verbatim, with only the regulated carrier changed."}]}
